name: VIEWPORT_SIZE
doc: Size of viewport (in pixels).

name: FRAGCOORD
doc: Coordinate of pixel center in screen space. xy specifies position in window. Origin is lower left. z specifies fragment depth. It is also used as the output value for the fragment depth unless DEPTH is written to.

name: FRONT_FACING
doc: true if current face is front facing, false otherwise.

name: VIEW
doc: Normalized vector from fragment position to camera (in view space). This is the same for both perspective and orthogonal cameras.

name: UV
doc: UV that comes from the vertex() function.

name: UV2
doc: UV2 that comes from the vertex() function.

name: COLOR
doc: COLOR that comes from the vertex() function.

name: POINT_COORD
doc: Point coordinate for drawing points with POINT_SIZE.

name: MODEL_MATRIX
doc: Model/local space to world space transform.

name: MODEL_NORMAL_MATRIX
doc: Model/local space to world space transform for normals. This is the same as MODEL_MATRIX by default unless the object is scaled non-uniformly, in which case this is set to transpose(inverse(mat3(MODEL_MATRIX))).

name: VIEW_MATRIX
doc: World space to view space transform.

name: INV_VIEW_MATRIX
doc: View space to world space transform.

name: PROJECTION_MATRIX
doc: View space to clip space transform.

name: INV_PROJECTION_MATRIX
doc: Clip space to view space transform.

name: NODE_POSITION_WORLD
doc: Node position, in world space.

name: NODE_POSITION_VIEW
doc: Node position, in view space.

name: CAMERA_POSITION_WORLD
doc: Camera position, in world space. Represents the midpoint of the two eyes when in multiview/stereo rendering.

name: CAMERA_DIRECTION_WORLD
doc: Camera direction, in world space.

name: CAMERA_VISIBLE_LAYERS
doc: Cull layers of the camera rendering the current pass.

name: VERTEX
doc: Position of the fragment (pixel), in view space. It is the VERTEX value from vertex() interpolated between the face's vertices and transformed into view space. If skip_vertex_transform is enabled, it may not be in view space.

name: LIGHT_VERTEX
doc: A writable version of VERTEX that can be used to alter light and shadows. Writing to this will not change the position of the fragment.

name: VIEW_INDEX
doc: The view that we are rendering. Used to distinguish between views in multiview/stereo rendering. VIEW_MONO_LEFT (0) for Mono (not multiview) or left eye, VIEW_RIGHT (1) for right eye.

name: VIEW_MONO_LEFT
doc: Constant for Mono or left eye, always 0.

name: VIEW_RIGHT
doc: Constant for right eye, always 1.

name: EYE_OFFSET
doc: Position offset for the eye being rendered, in view space. Only applicable for multiview rendering.

name: SCREEN_TEXTURE
doc: Removed in Godot 4. Use a sampler2D with hint_screen_texture instead.

name: SCREEN_UV
doc: Screen UV coordinate for current pixel.

name: DEPTH_TEXTURE
doc: Removed in Godot 4. Use a sampler2D with hint_depth_texture instead.

name: DEPTH
doc: Custom depth value (range of [0.0, 1.0]). If DEPTH is being written to in any shader branch, then you are responsible for setting the DEPTH for all other branches. Otherwise, the graphics API will leave them uninitialized.

name: NORMAL
doc: Normal that comes from the vertex() function, in view space. If skip_vertex_transform is enabled, it may not be in view space.

name: TANGENT
doc: Tangent that comes from the vertex() function, in view space. If skip_vertex_transform is enabled, it may not be in view space.

name: BINORMAL
doc: Binormal that comes from the vertex() function, in view space. If skip_vertex_transform is enabled, it may not be in view space.

name: NORMAL_MAP
doc: Set normal here if reading normal from a texture instead of NORMAL.

name: NORMAL_MAP_DEPTH
doc: Depth from NORMAL_MAP. Defaults to 1.0.

name: ALBEDO
doc: Albedo (default white). Base color.

name: ALPHA
doc: Alpha (range of [0.0, 1.0]). If read from or written to, the material will go to the transparent pipeline.

name: ALPHA_SCISSOR_THRESHOLD
doc: If written to, values below a certain amount of alpha are discarded.

name: ALPHA_HASH_SCALE
doc: Alpha hash scale when using the alpha hash transparency mode. Defaults to 1.0. Higher values result in more visible pixels in the dithering pattern.

name: ALPHA_ANTIALIASING_EDGE
doc: The threshold below which alpha to coverage antialiasing should be used. Defaults to 0.0. Requires the alpha_to_coverage render mode. Should be set to a value lower than ALPHA_SCISSOR_THRESHOLD to be effective.

name: ALPHA_TEXTURE_COORDINATE
doc: The texture coordinate to use for alpha-to-coverge antialiasing. Requires the alpha_to_coverage render mode. Typically set to UV * vec2(albedo_texture_size) where albedo_texture_size is the size of the albedo texture in pixels.

name: PREMUL_ALPHA_FACTOR
doc: Premultiplied alpha factor. Only effective if render_mode blend_premul_alpha; is used. This should be written to when using a shaded material with premultiplied alpha blending for interaction with lighting. This is not required for unshaded materials.

name: METALLIC
doc: Metallic (range of [0.0, 1.0]).

name: SPECULAR
doc: Specular (not physically accurate to change). Defaults to 0.5. 0.0 disables reflections.

name: ROUGHNESS
doc: Roughness (range of [0.0, 1.0]).

name: RIM
doc: Rim (range of [0.0, 1.0]). If used, Godot calculates rim lighting. Rim size depends on ROUGHNESS.

name: RIM_TINT
doc: Rim Tint, range of 0.0 (white) to 1.0 (albedo). If used, Godot calculates rim lighting.

name: CLEARCOAT
doc: Small specular blob added on top of the existing one. If used, Godot calculates clearcoat.

name: CLEARCOAT_GLOSS
doc: Gloss of clearcoat. If used, Godot calculates clearcoat.

name: ANISOTROPY
doc: For distorting the specular blob according to tangent space.

name: ANISOTROPY_FLOW
doc: Distortion direction, use with flowmaps.

name: SSS_STRENGTH
doc: Strength of subsurface scattering. If used, subsurface scattering will be applied to the object.

name: SSS_TRANSMITTANCE_COLOR
doc: Color of subsurface scattering transmittance. If used, subsurface scattering transmittance will be applied to the object.

name: SSS_TRANSMITTANCE_DEPTH
doc: Depth of subsurface scattering transmittance. Higher values allow the effect to reach deeper into the object.

name: SSS_TRANSMITTANCE_BOOST
doc: Boosts the subsurface scattering transmittance if set above 0.0. This makes the effect show up even on directly lit surfaces

name: BACKLIGHT
doc: Color of backlighting (works like direct light, but it's received even if the normal is slightly facing away from the light). If used, backlighting will be applied to the object. Can be used as a cheaper approximation of subsurface scattering.

name: AO
doc: Strength of ambient occlusion. For use with pre-baked AO.

name: AO_LIGHT_AFFECT
doc: How much ambient occlusion affects direct light (range of [0.0, 1.0], default 0.0).

name: EMISSION
doc: Emission color (can go over (1.0, 1.0, 1.0) for HDR).

name: FOG
doc: If written to, blends final pixel color with FOG.rgb based on FOG.a.

name: RADIANCE
doc: If written to, blends environment map radiance with RADIANCE.rgb based on RADIANCE.a.

name: IRRADIANCE
doc: If written to, blends environment map irradiance with IRRADIANCE.rgb based on IRRADIANCE.a.
